Cardmember Agreement and Schedule of Charges

The legally binding version of everything you saw in Key Terms — in a readable form, not a PDF dump.

How this card works

The Arta Card is a charge card: the full statement balance is due each cycle, and balances never revolve. There is no purchase APR because there is no borrowing — a finance charge applies only to amounts that remain unpaid after the due date.

The pledge

Your spending limit is secured by the assets you selected, custodied at BNY | Pershing. Advance rates by asset class are shown at all times. If pledged values fall, your limit adjusts with 7 days' notice; spending below the adjusted limit is never interrupted, and Arta never sells your assets without your instruction.

Fees
  • Annual fee: S$150, billed on your first statement and each anniversary.
  • Foreign transaction fee: none.
  • Late payment fee: up to S$40. We notify you before it is ever applied.
  • Cash advance APR: 29.99% variable, from the day of the advance.
Credit reporting

Submitting this application authorizes one hard credit inquiry. Your account activity — balances and payment history — is reported to Credit Bureau Singapore monthly.

Your right to information

If your application is declined or approved on different terms, you are entitled to a written statement of the specific reasons within 7 business days.

Autopay and payments

Settlement draws the full statement balance from your chosen source. You can switch source any time before 11:59 PM the day before the scheduled payment. If the source is short, we tell you before the due date — never after.

Questions about any clause? Ask Arta AI from any screen — explanations, not advice.
